Abstract
Protocol for the preparation of 0.1x BWT buffer (Wash buffer II) for automated single-stranded DNA library
preparation using the ssDNA2.0 method (Gansauge et al. 2020).
References
Gansauge, M.-T., Aximu-Petri, A., Nagel, S., & Meyer, M. (2020). Manual and automated preparation of single-
stranded DNA libraries for the sequencing of DNA from ancient biological remains and other sources of highly
degraded DNA. Nature Protocols, 15, 2279-2300.

translation_zh.title: 0.1xBWT 缓冲液配制
translation_zh.abstract_zh: 本方案描述 500 ml 缓冲液的配制方法。

steps.text_zh:
在 500 ml 方形试剂瓶中按下表加入各试剂配制缓冲液。转移大体积（> 1 ml）时使用玻璃移液管。通过摇动瓶子混匀试剂。

试剂 / 体积 / 反应中终浓度：
· Water — 483.75 ml
· 5 M NaCl — 10 ml — 100 mM
· 1 M Tris-HCl, pH 8.0 — 5 ml — 10 mM
· 0.5 M EDTA, pH 8.0 — 1 ml — 1 mM
· 100% Tween-20 — 0.25 ml — 0.05%
· 合计 — 500 ml
steps.source_text: Prepare the buffer in a 500 ml square media bottle by adding the following reagents. Use the glass pipette for transfer of large volumes (> 1 ml). Mix reagents by shaking the bottle. [Water 483.75 ml; 5 M NaCl 10 ml -> 100 mM; 1 M Tris-HCl pH 8.0 5 ml -> 10 mM; 0.5 M EDTA pH 8.0 1 ml -> 1 mM; 100% Tween-20 0.25 ml -> 0.05%; sum 500 ml]

steps.title_zh: 确认是否需要紫外去污
steps.text_zh: 查阅使用该缓冲液的具体方案，确定是否需要对缓冲液进行紫外（UV）去污处理。紫外去污的操作说明见附录。
steps.source_text: Review the protocol in which the buffer is used to determine whether the buffer should be decontaminated using UV treatment. Instructions for UV-decontamination are provided in the Appendix.

steps.text_zh: 缓冲液在室温下保存至使用。自配制之日起保质期至少一年。
steps.source_text: Store the buffer at room temperature until used. Shelf life is at least one year from preparation.

notes_zh: [补充] 也可以先利用瓶身刻度加水至 400 ml，再用玻璃移液管补加剩余约 84 ml。
[标签] 在瓶上标注缓冲液名称、批次编号（batch ID）、日期以及配制人姓名缩写。注意：同一天配制的每一瓶都要有各自新的批次编号。批次用罗马数字命名（如 batch I、batch II 等）。
[记录] 将配制所用试剂上的批号（lot number）、日期和姓名缩写记录到 Labfolder（橙色字段）中。
